nodes.name: Redis • Slot Lock (Atomic INCR + TTL)

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO omni_transactions (
  correlation_id,event_key,phone,contact_id,intent,status,
  appointment_event_id,appointment_start,appointment_end,error_code,
  raw_transcript,updated_at
) VALUES (
  $1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,
  NULLIF($8,'')::timestamptz,
  NULLIF($9,'')::timestamptz,
  $10,$11,NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (correlation_id) DO UPDATE SET
  event_key=EXCLUDED.event_key,
  phone=EXCLUDED.phone,
  contact_id=EXCLUDED.contact_id,
  intent=EXCLUDED.intent,
  status=EXCLUDED.status,
  appointment_event_id=EXCLUDED.appointment_event_id,
  appointment_start=EXCLUDED.appointment_start,
  appointment_end=EXCLUDED.appointment_end,
  error_code=EXCLUDED.error_code,
  raw_transcript=EXCLUDED.raw_transcript,
  updated_at=NOW()
RETURNING correlation_id;
